name: Lucien Neuschburn
original_name: ルーシェン・ノイシュバーン
source:
[i]“My promise with you has kept me alive.”[/i]

[i]Transformed Azure with a Frail Heart[/i]

The kindly third-born prince of the Kingdom of Hystorica. Due to his mother's low standing, he's been tormented by relatives for most of his life. Though he's one of the few contenders for the throne, his weak nature means few expect much out of him. After the heroine's first Fatal Rewind, however, that's all turned on its head. He becomes a capable, if callous, public figure.

What changed him, and which of these personas is the real him? The heroine's time-changing powers give her frustratingly little insight.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=lucien]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
